tasks.title: Forceable phone mode
tasks.summary: The app's switch between phone and desktop layouts can now be forced to phone mode, so the phone layout can be tested and shown on any screen size (#1437).

items.note: Decides when the app uses its phone layout; it can now be forced into phone mode instead of only following the screen width.
The page frame now follows the forceable phone-mode switch when choosing between the side menu and the bottom bar.
The phone's bottom menu bar appears whenever phone mode is on, including when it is forced.
The sign-in page frame uses the same phone-mode switch.

tasks.title: Change-password race test
tasks.summary: A server test that checks two password changes at the same moment was made to run the same way every time instead of depending on timing (#1442).

items.note: The test helper that steps in just before a database command was adjusted so the two password changes collide the same way every run.

tasks.title: Passkeys in the glossary
tasks.summary: The product glossary now defines passkeys as a second sign-in step, and the in-app glossary check was updated to match (#1445).

items.note: Tracks which glossary terms the in-app Help covers; updated for the new passkey entry.
